items.prompt: A solid object has mass 10 g and volume 2 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 11 m is to be paved at $4 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $484; the cost is proportional to the area
$176; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$44; the cost is proportional to the area
$484; the cost is proportional to the side length
